name: CI script environment exfiltration
description: Worked example of an effective test-stage mutant on the git target. Models unauthorized modification of a CI script to add behavior that collects and transmits sensitive environment data during test execution to an attacker-controlled mock endpoint. This operator carries an effect block so the validator can classify the mutant as 'effective' (not merely build_valid).

placeholders.CI_SCRIPT_FILE: relative path to the CI script selected for modification
placeholders.ANCHOR_LINE: existing script line used as the insertion point

preconditions: project or CI workflow executes a script during test execution
the attacker can modify the script content or its delivered contents
the script executes in an environment with access to variables or network connectivity
